Several employees "chose to follow" the Two Co-Founders to the new unit Microsoft AI

Michael SpencerMar 20, 2024∙ Paid214ShareHey Everyone, 

When I first read Inflection’s blog yesterday, I was livid. Microsoft was a major backer in Inflection AI’s last funding round in the Summer of 2023. Now fast forward a few months later, it appears Microsoft has poached the majority of the best talent from Inflection AI’s team. 

This amounted to a complete raid on the diversified and decentralized future of AI.
